messages:
maya-partners: Quick pulse: want to list our Vector Connector on GCP Marketplace and Databricks Partner Connect. Who can confirm packaging requirements and lead the manifest?

noah-marketing: We need a short product blurb, icon, and 1-min GIF. GCP also needs a pricing SKU example. Can we target assets by 2026-04-04?

tom-eng: I can own the manifest and packaging. Status: adapters/pinecone + adapters/redis smoke tests pass. Packaging checklist: container image in GCR, terraform sample, partnerConnect manifest. ETA: 4 days.

zara-legal: For GCP Marketplace we need a marketplace addendum and DP appendix if vectors leave the customer's cloud. @maya-partners please document which adapters may transmit vectors off-cloud.

maya-partners: Will do. Pinecone and hosted Weaviate may be external; Redis and managed cloud Redis can be in-customer VPC. I'll add a data residency table.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch feature/marketplace-packaging (build #9550) :white_check_mark:

noah-marketing: Also suggest a short joint webinar with Databricks showing Partner Connect setup + demo. If Databricks can provide a quote that helps. Budget tentative.

tom-eng: Added a demo notebook PR: examples/databricks/vector-quickstart.ipynb. Manifest stub below:
```yaml
partnerConnect:
  name: "Redwood Vector Connector"
  redirectUri: "https://app.redwood.dev/auth/db-callback"
  integrations: [pinecone, redis, weaviate]
```

maya-partners: Action items: Tom owns manifest + notebook (due +4 days). Legal drafts addendum (zara). Marketing prepares assets and pricing SKU (noah). I'll coordinate with Databricks PM for validation slot.

zara-legal: Noted. I'll start the draft addendum and confirm data handling language.

maya-partners: Great. I'll post the partnership tracker update and schedule a 30-min dry run for validation on 2026-04-06. Please attach PRs before EOD 2026-03-31. Thanks! :rocket:
